definitions.explanation: Doing something while clearly not wanting to do it. Conveys that the person complied but with obvious displeasure or resistance.

examples.japanese: {嫌々|いやいや}ながら⟦{引|ひ}き{受|う}けた→引き受ける：03140_hikiukeru⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{嫌々|いやいや}ながら⟦{宿題|しゅくだい}→宿題：00812_shukudai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: The child grudgingly started their homework.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{命令|めいれい}→命令：03754_meirei⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{嫌々|いやいや}ながら⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: Since it was my boss's order, I decided to work overtime even though I didn't want to.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{嫌々|いやいや}→嫌々：07795_iyaiya⟧ (unwillingly, a reduplication of ⟦{嫌|いや}→嫌：10232_iya⟧) and ⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧ (while/although). The word emphasizes that someone is doing something despite clearly not wanting to. Also written as いやいや⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧ without kanji.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {嫌々|いやいや}ながら⟦{引|ひ}き{受|う}ける→引き受ける：03140_hikiukeru⟧: to accept reluctantly
- {嫌々|いやいや}ながら⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: even though reluctantly (emphasizes compliance)
- {嫌々|いやいや}ながら⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧: to comply grudgingly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {渋々|しぶしぶ}: reluctantly — similar meaning, often interchangeable
- ⟦{仕方|しかた}なく→仕方ない：11434_shikatanai⟧: having no choice — emphasizes lack of alternatives
- ⟦{不本意|ふほんい}→不本意：11363_fuhoni⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧: against one's wishes — more formal
